title: WorkThanks - Data API
description: Represents the source and message of a thanks post.

FeedItemId.description: ID of the FeedItem related to the thanks badge. This is a relationship field.

GiverId.description: Salesforce user ID for the giver of the Thanks record. This is a relationship field.

Message.description: Message associated with the Thanks record.

NetworkId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
NetworkId.description: The ID of the community that this WorkThanks is associated with. This field is available only if digital experiences is enabled in your org.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: Salesforce user ID for the owner of the badge record (typically the same user as the giver of the record). This is a polymorphic relationship field.

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. Unless noted, they are available in the same API version as this object.

- **WorkThanksChangeEvent (API version 62.0)**: Change events are available for the object.
- **WorkThanksOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **WorkThanksShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
